processTiers.label: No land use application needed
processTiers.decider: nobody; the code allows it outright when its standards are met
processTiers.resident: If the standards in the cited sections are met, no planning application is needed. A building permit may still apply; check with the Building Department.

processTiers.label: Building permit with zoning compliance check
processTiers.decider: Building Official, with the Zoning Administrator checking zoning compliance
processTiers.resident: Apply to the Building Department. The Zoning Administrator checks the permit for zoning compliance under section 152-7-13.

processTiers.label: Zoning verification letter / administrative interpretation
processTiers.resident: The Zoning Administrator answers in writing. For a formal interpretation of the code the request follows section 152-7-18.

processTiers.label: Administrative approval by staff
processTiers.resident: Staff can approve this if every requirement in the cited sections is met. No public hearing is needed.

processTiers.label: Planning Commission decision
processTiers.decider: Planning Commission, after notice and a public meeting or hearing
processTiers.resident: The Planning Commission decides at a noticed meeting under section 152-7-4. Staff prepare a report; the Commission may approve, approve with conditions, or deny.

processTiers.label: Variance (Hearing Officer)
processTiers.resident: A variance is a narrow form of relief for an unreasonable hardship caused by the property itself. The Hearing Officer decides under section 152-7-12.

processTiers.label: City Council decision (legislative)
processTiers.decider: City Council, after a Planning Commission hearing and recommendation
processTiers.resident: A zoning map or text amendment is a legislative decision. The Planning Commission holds a hearing and recommends; the City Council decides under section 152-7-7.

processTiers.label: Complaint for Code Enforcement
processTiers.decider: Zoning Administrator (zoning violations) or Animal Control / Code Enforcement (animals, nuisances)
processTiers.resident: A complaint report goes to the enforcement office. The code's notice-and-cure procedure is in section 152-9-8.

processTiers.label: Not a land use matter
processTiers.resident: This belongs with another department. The help desk hands you there with a note.

lot_split.name: Lot split (one new lot, staff approval)

wording.fee: Fees are set by the city's schedule of fees (section 152-7-3); the City Recorder has the current amounts.
wording.timing: Timing depends on when the application is complete and, for hearings, on the notice period in section 152-7-4. Staff can give current meeting dates.
wording.staffDecide: Only real City Officials can make decisions.
